reproduction_before_change.claim: audit claim 6: notional_target_v1 flat or weaker view neither closes nor trims
reproduction_before_change.cmd: PYTHONPATH=. python3 repro.py (outside repo; decide_validated on a held 10-unit eq:2330 long, FLAT view and LONG strength 0.2)

change.flat_view: FLAT with an open position on the underlying emits close_leg of the whole held leg (one leg per call, same as opposite-view close); no position keeps flat_view; held leg missing from candidates fails closed as no_feasible_instrument / close_instrument_not_in_candidates
change.weaker_view: same-direction holding is trimmed when exposure - target > band, band = max(largest held unit notional, target * rebalance_band_fraction); units = floor(held * (exposure - target) / exposure), never above held; target = strength * notional_fraction_at_full_strength * gross_limit (absolute limit, so a held position does not shrink its own target); record carries additive rebalance_band
change.stronger_view: unchanged: adds only when allow_pyramiding is true
change.band_value: NOTIONAL_REBALANCE_BAND_FRACTION = 0.2, COORDINATOR PROPOSAL (2026-11-13 PERSONA-POOL-TARGET-POSITIONS-20261113) for reviewer confirmation; read from the rebalance_band_fraction policy parameter when present
change.not_merged_into_DEFAULT_PARAMETERS: so policy_parameters_digest of existing decisions and the multi-member envelope parameters stay byte identical (digests 21506025fd1f63344919806d defaults, 1124d9c76fdca98ddda3d10f with band 0.2, both pinned in test_portfolio_envelope_parity.py)
change.limitation: services/registry/strategy_artifact.py rejects rebalance_band_fraction for notional_target_v1 artifacts and is outside the artifact list, so an artifact cannot yet carry its own band; the module default applies. Follow-up task needed if per-artifact bands are wanted.
